title: ID0376120-DC/Si-D/BE[170001626 & 170001557] - CCV wrong key
description:
Reported behaviour/issue:
CCV is giving error code 8 during commissioning. We contacted ccv regarding to this problem they said us that these terminals needs to be replaced because they have the wrong "key"
Root cause:
According to R&D and supplier needs a new CCV
Solution:
CCV’s are replaced and commissioned.
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
Siemens
Warranty Status:
Active
